# TMs and HMs

Every TM and HM of the original games teaches the same move here. Black 2 numbers its TMs differently, so a TM of the original games is the Black 2 TM that teaches the same move. Pearl's moves that Black 2 has no TM for are new TMs, TM96 to TM120.

HM moves are ordinary moves here: they can be forgotten, and a Pokémon that knows one can be traded.

## Field moves work with the badge

You don't need to teach a field move. Once you have its badge, it works: facing a rock, a tree, the water or a wall, or under the fog. You need neither the HM in your Bag nor a Pokémon that knows the move: the first Pokémon that knows it is shown using it, or else the first in your party that isn't an Egg.

| Move | Item | Badge |
|---|---|---|
| Rock Smash | TM94 | Coal Badge |
| Cut | HM01 | Forest Badge |
| Fly | HM02 | Cobble Badge |
| Defog | TM119 | Fen Badge |
| Surf | HM03 | Relic Badge |
| Strength | HM04 | Mine Badge |
| Rock Climb | TM120 | Icicle Badge |
| Waterfall | HM05 | Beacon Badge |

Flash is an ordinary TM with no badge: a Pokémon must know it. With the Cobble Badge, Fly opens from the Town Map in your Bag. With the Fen Badge, pressing A under the deep fog offers Defog.
